title: Load-bearing citation v1: provisional doctrine with a decay clock
subject: load-bearing-citation
ratio: (1) A citation counts as a reputation event only when it is load-bearing: the cited ratio actually constrained the citing decision, confirmed at verification time, not merely named in prose. (2) The v1 operationalization is T-367's seven-step heuristic and it is PROVISIONAL DOCTRINE by the addendum's own instruction. (3) Only steps 1-4 are MECHANIZABLE and only they ship in Phase A; steps 5-7 are exhibit-or-judgment and print as NOT COMPUTED, never guessed. (4) cited_by's raw count is the crudest possible any-mention measure and must never be used as a proxy for load-bearing citations received: cited_by is appended identically for a bare cites token and for a typed relation. (5) The decay clock is this record's own revisit_trigger and it is the record's own terms, not an aspiration: either crossing retires v1 and routes to the adjudication mechanism for a v2. (6) Neither crossing auto-demotes any citation, record or identity: Phase A flags, it never fines.
scope_conditions: any reader counting citations received as a reputation figure
revisit_trigger: Revisit when the ratio of load-bearing-confirmed citations to all Step-6-answered citations drops below 0.5 across 10 or more citations targeting one record or across 30 or more registry-wide within one epic, or when a single confirming identity renders more than 60 percent of all Step-6 load-bearing verdicts with at least 5 rendered
validity_conditions: no relation field carries a load-bearing verdict; confirmed_by is one scalar per record on the scope lifecycle
cited_by is populated identically for a bare cites token and for a typed relation
